import sys

def main():
    text = sys.stdin.readline().strip()
    pairs = 0
    
    if not text:
        print(0)
        return
    
    chars = list(text)
    last_char = chars[0]
    consecutive = 1
    
    for i in range(1, len(chars)):
        if chars[i] == last_char:
            consecutive += 1
        else:
            if consecutive % 2 == 0:
                pairs += 1
            last_char = chars[i]
            consecutive = 1
    
    if consecutive % 2 == 0:
        pairs += 1
    
    print(pairs)

if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()
